note: Woodbury County Conservation park 2 mi SW of Correctionville on the Little Sioux River, 609 acres with a 10-acre fishing lake (electric motors only), swim beach, trails, a shooting range and the Union Bridge Trail into town. Campers check in after 4 pm. --Claude
summary: Booking FCFS-only -> reservable online (MyCountyParks since July 15, 2026), fcfs always -> never; fees added $25-30; hookups, 109 sites, showers/flush/dump and May 1-Oct 31 confirmed. Waterfront lead pond -> not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD DOWN, pond -> not waterfront. The water body is not a pond: the operator calls it 'The 10-acre lake' (over the ~5-acre line). But no RV site is on or in view of it: the Riverside herringbone loop (centre ~42.4477,-95.7976) is ~110-130 m east of the lake's head across the park road, a shelter/day-use lawn and a tree row; the Bellamy loop (~42.4530,-95.7958) is ~300 m north of it. The only campsites by the lake are the ~14 non-electric/tent sites 'on the west side of the lake' (not shown as RV sites). The Little Sioux River beside the Riverside loop is a ~40-100 m wide sandbar channel (riverfront width), but it runs 40-80 m east of the loop's outer pads behind a continuous dense tree belt, so no on-water or view candidate there either (imagery estimates; Overpass/Nominatim down).
